templates.name: Pool
templates.description: Quarterly pool water quality, equipment, and safety equipment inspection.

steps.label: Check the water level.
Check the water temperature. Recommended temperatures are 85° for the pool.
Check water clarity. Drain and refill only if necessary.
Check all pool chemical levels. Record appropriately in the Pool Operator’s Log. Ensure this is being completed daily.
Check the condition of all ladders, cove molding, and rescue equipment.
Vacuum and brush all tiled surfaces and pool floor as needed.
Make sure all proper signage is posted.

templates.name: Elevator Checklist
templates.description: Monthly elevator preventive maintenance and safety checklist. Assign this template to each applicable elevator or elevator equipment area.

steps.label: Check the general condition of all elevators.
Check and clean elevator pits and tracks.
Test the fire recall system.
Test the elevator safety phone.
Check that elevator/pump rooms are clean.
Test emergency lighting.
Complete any required elevator safety inspections or checks applicable to the property.

templates.name: Administrative Offices
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Fire Extinguishers
templates.description: Monthly fire extinguisher inspection. Assign this template to all applicable property locations; long-term vendor testing is managed separately.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition of each fire extinguisher.
Confirm each extinguisher is present and properly positioned.
Inspect cabinets and mounting brackets; clean as needed.
Inspect extinguisher hoses for visible damage.
Confirm inspection tags are signed and dated monthly and annually.
Confirm each extinguisher indicates proper charge.

templates.name: Building Exterior
templates.description: Triannual building exterior/envelope inspection covering finishes, openings, seals, and visible deterioration. Assign to the property exterior or primary building area.

steps.label: Inspect building exterior walls, cladding, trim, and finishes for visible damage, deterioration, cracks, staining, or loose materials.
Inspect windows, doors, frames, seals, and caulking for damage, gaps, failed sealant, or signs of water intrusion.
Inspect exterior building fixtures attached to the structure (such as soffits, fascia, and wall-mounted building elements) for damage or deterioration.
Clean and complete minor routine building-exterior repairs as needed.

templates.name: Parking Lot & Grounds
templates.description: Quarterly parking lot and grounds inspection covering pavement, sidewalks, striping, site fixtures, lighting, landscaping, and drainage.

steps.label: Inspect parking lot pavement and drive lanes for potholes, cracking, settlement, deterioration, or other damage.
Inspect sidewalks, curbs, ramps, and walking surfaces for cracks, uneven surfaces, damage, or trip hazards.
Inspect parking-space striping, directional markings, fire-lane markings, and accessible parking markings/signage for visibility and condition.
Inspect wheel stops, bollards, fencing, gates, and other site fixtures where installed for damage or loose/unsafe conditions.
Inspect exterior site lighting and signage for damage and proper operation.
Inspect landscaping and grounds for overgrowth, dead or damaged vegetation, irrigation issues, erosion, or conditions affecting sidewalks, buildings, lighting, or guest access.
Inspect visible parking-lot/site drainage areas for blockage, standing water, erosion, or drainage problems.

templates.name: Corridors (Hallways)
templates.description: Quarterly corridor and hallway condition inspection by floor.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Boilers / Water Heaters
templates.description: PM Water Heaters #1, #2, #3, #4

steps.label: Ensure there are no leaks and record the temperature.
Drain water off the bottom valve unit until clear water is present.
Ensure that the pressure relief valve is sized properly and there are no leaks. Record the temperature.
Check the water temperature in a room (120° - 125° maximum).
Clean the burner assembly and check circulation pumps are working properly

templates.name: Dining & Breakfast Area
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for the dining and breakfast area.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition.
Inspect tables, chairs, and other furniture for damage, loose components, scratches, or finish wear. Tighten and make minor cosmetic repairs as needed.
Inspect breakfast/buffet counters, surfaces, hardware, and service fixtures for damage or deterioration.
Test GFCI outlets for proper operation.

templates.name: Dumpster Area
templates.description: Quarterly dumpster area inspection covering cleanliness, enclosure condition, and surrounding maintenance needs.

steps.label: Inspect the dumpster area for trash, debris, stains, spills, and odors.
Inspect the dumpster enclosure, gates, hinges, and latches for proper condition and operation.
Inspect walls, pavement, curbs, and the surrounding area for damage or other maintenance needs.
Clean and pressure wash the dumpster area as needed.

templates.name: Employee Breakroom
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Employee Restroom
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Check the following and repair as needed: Walls, floors, ceilings, hardware, toilet
Touch up door frames
Clean and inspect the exhaust fan.

templates.name: Boiler/Water Heater Room
templates.description: PM Hot Water Heater Room

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Ensure that all electrical panels and disconnects are properly labeled.
Organize and inventory tools and supplies.

templates.name: Electrical Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly electrical room area inspection covering room condition, ventilation, combustibles, and panel filler blanks.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition.
Inspect doors, frames, and hardware; touch up or repair as needed.
Verify exhaust ventilation is operating and pulling air properly.
Ensure the room is clean, clear, and accessible.
Ensure no combustible materials are stored in the electrical room.
Inspect electrical panels for open or missing breaker blanks; install approved fillers as needed.

templates.name: Emergency Lights
templates.description: Quarterly emergency lighting inspection covering lamp operation, test buttons, and battery condition.

steps.label: Inspect all lights, and replace any that are burned out. All floors.
Ensure that all emergency lights work by pressing the red “Test” button.
Check the battery charge. Replace any defective or dead batteries as soon as possible.

templates.name: Relay
templates.description: Quarterly relay and beacon device battery and alarm function inspection.

steps.label: Change beacon batteries located throughout the building.
Ensure all devices are working properly. Test alarm feature for all devices.
Relay Admin Portal and review beacon locations are functioning properly

templates.name: Engineering Shop
templates.description: Quarterly engineering shop inspection covering room finishes, organization, and cleanliness.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Touch up door frames.
Organize paperwork, tools and equipment

templates.name: Entry Foyer
templates.description: Quarterly entry foyer inspection covering finishes, doors, locks/intercom, luggage cart parking area, and exterior entrance surfaces.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition.
Touch up doors and door frames as needed.
Test entrance door locks and intercom, if applicable.
Inspect the luggage cart storage/parking area and repair as needed.
Power wash entrance walkways, walls, columns, and other exterior surfaces as needed.

templates.name: Public HVAC / Common Area AC Units
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for common-area HVAC / AC units, with each unit tracked as its own PM item.

steps.label: Inspect the overall condition and operation of the HVAC unit; check for unusual noise, vibration, icing, corrosion, water leakage, or other visible deficiencies.
Inspect air filter condition and clean or replace as needed; verify the filter is properly installed and seated.
Inspect evaporator and condenser coils for dirt, debris, damage, corrosion, or bent fins; clean as needed.
Clean and vacuum the condensate drain line. Inspect and clean the drain pan and verify proper drainage with no blockage, buildup, standing water, or leaks.
Inspect blower/fan assembly, motor, and accessible components for cleanliness, secure mounting, damage, and abnormal noise or vibration.
Inspect accessible electrical wiring, connections, disconnects, and components for looseness, damage, overheating, or corrosion.
Inspect accessible refrigerant lines and insulation for damage, deterioration, oil residue, icing, or other indications of a refrigerant-system problem.
Inspect belts, pulleys, and related drive components for wear, damage, alignment, and proper tension where equipped.
Verify thermostat/control operation and confirm the unit starts, operates, cycles, and shuts down properly.

legacyNames: Front Desk - Public Space VTEC Unit

templates.name: Fire System Flow
templates.description: Quarterly fire system flow and contracted inspection tracking checklist.

steps.label: Contract out - Annual Alarm Panel Inspection
Contract out - Annual testing and Maintenance of Standpipe and Hose Systems
Contract out - Quarterly Testing and Maintenance of Wet Pipe Sprinkler System
Contract out - Annual Fire Hydrant Flow Test
Contract Out - Annual, all Backflows, Prevention Assembly Test
Contract out - Annual Testing and Maintenance of Wet Pipe Sprinkler System

templates.name: Fitness Center
templates.description: Quarterly fitness center area and equipment preventive maintenance.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the fitness center as needed: doors, locks, walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition.
Inspect fitness equipment for proper operation, loose or damaged components, hardware, cords, and connections. Tighten, lubricate, or repair as needed.
Test fitness center door lock and guest key access for proper operation.

templates.name: Roof
templates.description: Quarterly roof and building-area inspection covering surface condition, flashing, drainage, access, ventilation, and shingle areas where applicable.

steps.label: Inspect the roof surface for damage, excessive wear, cracking, blistering, loose or missing roofing material, ponding water, or other deterioration.
Inspect seams, flashing, pitch pockets, penetrations, parapets, and equipment curbs for gaps, damage, loose materials, failed sealant, or signs of water intrusion.
Clean and clear roof drains, scuppers, gutters, and strainers where installed; remove leaves, vegetation, and other debris from the roof.
Inspect walk pads, roof access areas, ladders/hatches, and designated service paths for damage, looseness, or unsafe conditions.
Inspect visible roof ventilation components and verify vents are unobstructed and in good condition.
For shingled roof areas, inspect for loose, missing, damaged, or curled shingles, excessive granule loss, and exposed or popped fasteners.

templates.name: Rooftop Exhausts
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop exhaust fan preventive maintenance. Add additional exhaust items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition and operation of the exhaust fan; check for unusual noise, vibration, corrosion, damage, or loose components.
Inspect accessible electrical connections and control wiring for looseness, damage, overheating, or corrosion.
Inspect and clean the fan wheel/blades and fan-blade guard; verify components are secure and free of excessive buildup.
Inspect the motor and bearings for proper operation, excessive noise, vibration, overheating, or wear; lubricate only where required by the equipment manufacturer.
Inspect belts and pulleys where equipped for wear, damage, proper tension, and alignment.
Inspect dampers for damage, buildup, binding, and proper operation.
Inspect accessible ductwork and connections for damage, deterioration, loose connections, water intrusion, or trapped water.

templates.name: Rooftop Units
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop unit (RTU) preventive maintenance. Checklist steps to be added later. Each RTU item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect overall unit condition and operation; check for unusual noise, vibration, or damage
Inspect and replace/clean filters as needed
If specialized service or repairs are needed, contact a qualified technician

templates.name: Housekeeping Carts
templates.description: Quarterly housekeeping cart inspection covering wheels, hardware, and finish.

steps.label: Inspect carts for overall condition, damage, loose components, and safe operation.
Inspect wheels and casters; tighten, repair, lubricate, or replace as needed.
Tighten loose nuts, bolts, handles, shelves, and supports as needed.
Clean carts and touch up damaged finishes as needed.

templates.name: Luggage Carts
templates.description: Monthly luggage cart inspection covering wheels, hardware, carpet/platform, bumpers, and finish.

steps.label: Inspect cart for overall condition, damage, loose components, and safe operation.
Inspect wheels and casters; tighten, lubricate, repair, or replace as needed.
Tighten loose nuts, bolts, handles, rails, and supports as needed.
Inspect carpet/platform and protective bumpers; clean, secure, or repair as needed.
Clean and polish cart surfaces as needed.

templates.name: Water Softener
templates.description: Quarterly water softener inspection covering condition, salt/brine levels, hardness, leaks, and normal operation.

steps.label: Inspect the overall condition and operation of the water softener for visible damage, leaks, corrosion, or abnormal conditions.
Inspect the salt/brine tank and verify salt and water levels are appropriate; check for salt bridging or excessive buildup.
Test water hardness to verify the system is providing properly softened water.
Inspect accessible piping, fittings, valves, and drain lines for leaks, damage, blockage, or improper drainage.
Verify the unit shows normal operation with no visible alarms, error codes, or other indications that service is required.

templates.name: Refrigerators / Freezers / Coolers
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for refrigerators, freezers, buffet coolers, and similar self-contained refrigeration equipment. Each unit keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect and clean the interior and exterior; inspect doors, hinges, gaskets, and seals for damage and proper closure/sealing.
Check operating temperature and verify the unit is maintaining the proper temperature for its intended use; verify proper interior airflow and that vents are not obstructed.
Inspect and clean condenser coils; inspect evaporator coils for dirt, debris, frost, ice buildup, damage, or bent fins and clean as needed.
Inspect and clean the condensate pan and clear/clean the condensate drain line; verify proper drainage with no blockage, buildup, standing water, or leaks.
Inspect the power cord, plug, accessible electrical connections, and controls for damage, looseness, overheating, or improper operation.
Operate the unit and check for unusual noise, vibration, leaks, excessive cycling, icing, or other signs of improper operation.
Clean underneath and behind the unit; remove dust, grease, debris, and anything obstructing ventilation.

templates.name: Chlorine Feeders
templates.description: Semiannual chlorine feeder inspection and routine maintenance. Assign to the pool equipment room or applicable chemical feed area.

steps.label: Inspect general condition of chlorine feeder(s).
Inspect lid, seals, fittings, and connections for visible wear or damage.
Inspect input and output hoses for leaks, cracks, deterioration, or loose connections.
Clean accessible components as needed.
Verify feeder appears to be operating normally.
Contact the pool service provider or qualified contractor for chemical-system repairs or service beyond routine maintenance.

templates.name: Juice Machine
templates.description: Quarterly juice machine inspection covering operation, electrical connections, leaks, and sanitation.

steps.label: Clean and inspect the machine for proper operation.
Inspect the electrical cord, plug, and accessible connections for damage.
Inspect for leaks and check accessible hoses, fittings, and connections.
Clean and sanitize dispensing nozzles and accessible product-contact areas per manufacturer recommendations.

templates.name: Ice Machines
templates.description: Quarterly ice machine inspection covering operation, drains, condenser, leveling, ice quality, filter, and sanitation.

steps.label: Inspect the overall condition and operation of the ice machine.
Inspect discharge/drain lines and ensure they are secure and properly directed to the drain.
Inspect condenser coil/fins; clean and straighten as needed.
Inspect the unit for proper positioning and level.
Inspect accessible electrical connections for damage or looseness.
Inspect ice cube size, shape, and overall ice quality.
Inspect the water filter and replace as needed.
Clean and sanitize accessible ice-making components and bin per manufacturer recommendations.

templates.name: Commercial Dishwasher / Sanitizer
templates.description: Monthly preventive maintenance for commercial dishwashing and sanitizing equipment.

steps.label: Inspect the unit for overall condition, cleanliness, and proper operation.
Inspect accessible electrical cord, plug, connections, hoses, and piping for damage or leaks.
Check water supply and verify proper water flow.
Verify wash and rinse temperatures are within the manufacturer's required operating range.
Clean accessible screens, spray arms, nozzles, filters, and internal surfaces as needed.
Delime the unit as needed according to manufacturer instructions and property water conditions.
Inspect and clean the drain and drain area as needed.
Run a complete test cycle and verify proper operation.

templates.name: Commercial Dryer
templates.description: Preventive maintenance for commercial dryers. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Run dryer and listen for excessive noise or vibration.
Inspect and clean lint screen, lint compartment, and accessible lint buildup.
Inspect drive belts for looseness, wear, cracks, or fraying.
Inspect door, hinges, latch, and door gasket for wear or damage.
Inspect and clean accessible burner area and burner air openings.
Inspect and clean accessible exhaust duct and vent for lint buildup or restriction.
Check accessible fasteners and hardware for looseness; tighten as needed.
Contact a qualified contractor for gas-system repairs, burner service, electrical repairs, or specialized repairs as needed.

templates.name: Commercial Washing Machine
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for commercial washing machines. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Inspect the machine for damage, excessive vibration, unusual noise, or other abnormal conditions.
Clean the drain trough/lint trap and remove accumulated debris.
Inspect water supply hoses, valves, and connections for leaks, wear, or damage.
Inspect chemical dispensing lines and connections for leaks or damage.
Inspect and clean accessible drain lines and components as needed.
Inspect accessible wiring and electrical components for damage or signs of overheating.
Inspect accessible belts and mechanical components for excessive wear or damage.
Clean accessible equipment and service areas of dust, lint, and debris.
Lubricate serviceable components only as recommended by the equipment manufacturer.
Run a test cycle and verify proper filling, washing, draining, and extraction.

templates.name: Laundry Room
templates.description: Quarterly laundry room area inspection covering finishes, utilities, linen chute, and restricted access.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the laundry room as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, doors, and general condition.
Inspect exposed pipes, drains, and utility connections for leaks, damage, or buildup.
Inspect the linen chute and chute door for damage, proper closure, cleanliness, and obstructions.
Verify restricted/associate-only access is secure and functioning properly.

templates.name: Property Lighting & Signage
templates.description: Quarterly property-wide interior and exterior lighting and signage inspection.

steps.label: Inspect all interior and exterior lighting; verify fixtures are working properly and replace failed lamps/bulbs as needed.
Inspect and clean accessible lenses, covers, and fixtures as needed.
Inspect exterior lighting for obstructions and correct as needed.
Verify exterior lighting controls, timers, and photocells operate at the proper times.
Inspect interior and exterior signage for damage, visibility, illumination, and secure mounting; repair as needed.

templates.name: Linen and Storage Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly linen and storage room area inspection covering finishes, shelving, plumbing, and clear access.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the room as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, doors, shelving, and general condition.
Inspect shelving, cabinets, and storage racks for damage, loose components, and secure mounting.
Inspect sinks, drains, and exposed plumbing for leaks or damage, where applicable.
Verify aisles, doors, and access points remain clear and unobstructed.

templates.name: Guest Dryer
templates.description: Quarterly guest dryer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run dryer through a complete cycle and verify proper operation, heat, and no excessive noise or vibration.
Clean around and behind the unit; inspect for damage or loose components.
Vacuum and clean accessible exhaust duct and vent; remove lint buildup as needed.
Inspect power cord, connections, door, and lint screen for damage or proper operation.

templates.name: Guest Washer
templates.description: Quarterly guest washer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run washer through a complete cycle and verify proper filling, washing, draining, spinning, and no excessive noise or vibration.
Inspect hoses, connections, door/lid seal, and gaskets for leaks, wear, or damage.
Clean around, behind, and under the unit; remove debris and inspect for signs of leaks.
Clean detergent/softener dispensers and accessible drain/filter areas as needed.
Inspect power cord, controls, door/lid, and exterior for damage or proper operation.

templates.name: Lobby & Front Desk
templates.description: Quarterly lobby, front desk, and market area public-space inspection.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the lobby and front desk area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, doors, front desk, furniture, and general condition.
Inspect the Market area and repair or replace cabinetry, shelving, fixtures, and equipment as needed.
Test lobby/front desk door locks, access hardware, and intercom/communication equipment, where applicable.
Ensure all common-area TVs are working properly.

templates.name: Vacuums
templates.description: Quarterly vacuum cleaner inspection and service. Add additional vacuum items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect the overall condition of the vacuum, including housing, wheels, handle, hose, wand, and attachments for damage, excessive wear, or loose components.
Inspect the power cord, plug, switches, and accessible electrical components for fraying, cuts, damage, overheating, or improper operation.
Inspect and clean the hose, wand, intake passages, and attachments; remove any clogs or obstructions.
Inspect and clean the brush roll/beater bar; remove hair, string, carpet fibers, and other wrapped debris.
Inspect the brush roll, belt, and roller assembly for wear, damage, proper movement, and tension; replace worn components as needed.
Inspect and clean or replace bags and filters as applicable; verify filters are properly installed and airflow is not restricted.
Test-run the vacuum and verify proper suction, brush operation, normal sound, and overall working condition.

templates.name: Meeting Room
templates.description: Quarterly meeting room area inspection covering finishes, flooring, AV/equipment, locks, and HVAC.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, furniture, and general condition.
Deep clean flooring as needed, including carpet extraction/shampooing or appropriate hard-floor cleaning.
Inspect and test meeting room equipment as applicable, including screens, projectors/displays, phones, and connection jacks.
Test doors and locks.
Test HVAC operation and confirm the room reaches and maintains the appropriate temperature.

templates.name: Outdoor Furniture
templates.description: Quarterly outdoor furniture inspection for pool and fire pit seating areas.

steps.label: Inspect furniture for damage, cracks, loose parts, or excessive wear.
Tighten loose hardware and fasteners as needed.
Inspect tables and chairs for stability; repair as needed.
Clean furniture and remove stains, dirt, mildew, and debris.
Inspect finishes for fading, peeling, rust, or corrosion; touch up as needed.
Inspect outdoor furniture surfaces for water intrusion, swelling, deterioration, or failed protective finish; reseal/waterproof as needed based on the furniture material.
Confirm furniture is properly positioned and the area is neat and orderly.

templates.name: Pool/Spa Circulation Pump
templates.description: Quarterly pool/spa circulation pump inspection covering mounting, flow, strainer, seals, wiring, and exterior condition.

steps.label: Inspect pump and motor for overall condition, secure mounting, proper grounding, and normal operation.
Verify proper water flow and listen for unusual noise or vibration.
Clean pump basket/strainer and remove debris; purge air as needed after servicing.
Inspect pump housing, lid, seals, and accessible piping for leaks or deterioration.
Inspect accessible electrical wiring and connections for damage, looseness, or corrosion.
Clean exterior surfaces and remove dirt, moisture, or oxidation buildup.

templates.name: Pool/Spa Filter
templates.description: Quarterly pool/spa filter inspection covering housing, pressure, valves, media service/backwash when applicable, flow, and exterior cleaning.

steps.label: Inspect filter tank/housing, piping, fittings, valves, clamps, and connections for leaks, cracks, deterioration, or damage.
Inspect the pressure gauge for proper condition and operation; compare operating pressure with the established clean/start pressure and manufacturer specifications.
Inspect and operate accessible valves, air-relief components, and emergency shutoffs; verify proper condition and operation.
Clean or service the filter as appropriate for the installed system (sand, cartridge, or DE); backwash when applicable and according to manufacturer requirements.
Inspect accessible filter elements/media, seals, O-rings, clamps, drain components, and hardware for wear, deterioration, or damage.
Verify proper water flow through the filtration system and investigate abnormal pressure or restricted flow.
Clean the exterior of the filter and remove dirt, chemical residue, and buildup.

templates.name: Pool Heater
templates.description: Quarterly pool heater inspection covering shutoffs, ignition, pipes, fans, and burners.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition of emergency shutoffs.
Inspect the general condition of outgoing temperature.
Inspect ignition device.
Inspect pipes.
Check water temperature in pool.
Inspect room intake fan(s) and exhaust fan(s).
Clean burners.

templates.name: Phone/TV/Computer Room
templates.description: Quarterly phone/TV/computer room area inspection covering finishes, temperature, access, cleanliness, and equipment clearance.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition.
Verify room temperature is maintained at 75°F or below.
Inspect door, frame, lock, and hardware; repair or touch up as needed.
Ensure the room is clean, dry, unobstructed, and free of unnecessary storage.
Verify equipment, panels, and electrical components have adequate clearance and ventilation.

templates.name: Public Restrooms
templates.description: Quarterly public restroom area inspection covering finishes, fixtures, plumbing, accessibility hardware, ventilation, and drains.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, doors, and general condition.
Inspect toilets, urinals, sinks, faucets, flush valves, supply lines, drains, and exposed plumbing for leaks, damage, proper operation, and proper drainage.
Inspect restroom partitions, stall doors, latches, hinges, toilet seats, and hardware; tighten or repair as needed.
Inspect grab bars and other accessible restroom fixtures/hardware for secure mounting, damage, and unobstructed access.
Inspect sinks, countertops, mirrors, dispensers, hand dryers, and other restroom accessories for damage and proper operation.
Inspect caulk, grout, and sealant around plumbing fixtures, countertops, walls, and flooring for cracking, separation, deterioration, mold, or water intrusion.
Inspect and clean the exhaust grille/fan; verify proper airflow and investigate excessive moisture or persistent odors.
Inspect floor drains, where installed, for blockage, drainage, and signs of odor or a dry trap.
Inspect applicable electrical receptacles/GFCI protection for damage and proper operation in accordance with property procedures.
Inspect vending or hygiene-product dispensers, where installed, for secure mounting and proper operation.

templates.name: Stairwells
templates.description: Quarterly stairwell finishes, lighting, and handrail inspection.

steps.label: Check all of the following, and clean, repair, re-paint, or replace as needed: walls, vinyl, door jambs, ceiling, carpets, cove base, outlets, signage, lights, and hand railing.
